To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Cys loop is a key control element for the allosteric modulation of the α4β nicotinic acetycholine receptor.

we identified the binding sites for two potentiating ligands of α4β nicotinic acetyicholine receptors (βEST and dFBR), and found that the Cys loop plays a key role in transducing the binding of these potentiating ligand into increased channel gating.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of allosteric binding sites and the pathways that link these sites with the channel gate.
the identification of allosteric modulatory sites and the elucidation of their mechanisms of action.
the molecular mechanism of allosteric modulator action on pentameric liganded gated ion channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Cys loop is a critical control element in the transduction pathway for positive allosteric modulation of the α4β subunit of the α4-β2 nicotin receptor by βEST and dFB.
the Cys loop is a critical control element in allosteric transductions that couple agonist and positive allosteric ligand binding to channel gating.

the binding sites of positive allosteric ligands of pentameric receptors, such as the α4β4 nicotinic receptors, can be identified by homology modelling, and that the binding sites can be confirmed by mutagenesis and functional studies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
positive modulators act on two pathways, one in the M3-M3 cavity, and one in post-M4, that both converge onto a single pathway that links the modulator binding site to the Cys Loop.
positive allosterimodulation of α4 β2 nAChRs is achieved through interactions between the Cys loop and the binding site for the modulator.

the Cys loop serves a critical function in the allosterism of pentameric ion channels, acting as a key control point for the transduction of signals from allosteric modulator binding sites to channel gating.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Cys loop is an important control element in the pathways that couple binding of allosteric modu- lators to channel gating.
the Cys loop is a critical element in the allo-steric transduction pathways for modulators of α4βn receptors.
the Cys loop is an important element in the allo-steric transduction pathways for modulators that bind either the post-M4 or M3-M4 region of the α subunit.
